problem_statement: The bitfield module should provide three new functions: bf_find_first_set, bf_find_first_unset, and bf_set_all. bf_find_first_set must return the lowest index of a set bit in a bitfield when given a bitfield and a number of bits, or -1 if no bit in that range is set. bf_find_first_unset must return the lowest index of an unset bit in a bitfield when given a bitfield and a number of bits, or -1 if all bits in that range are set. bf_set_all must set every bit with an index less than the given number of bits to 1, using the existing bitfield bit numbering, and must not change bytes completely outside that bit range.
